slides.exact_on_image_text:
तू चुप हो जाए तो घर में आवाज़ें भी डर-डर के चलती हैं।”
When you go silent,
even the house starts walking carefully.
slides.visual_proof_needed: The room behaves carefully around Aachu's silence.

scene_options.environment: Bedroom/living-room corner after a quiet fight.
scene_options.face_visibility_plan: Aachu in soft three-quarter profile, Zuv partially face-visible in doorway.
scene_options.body_language: Aachu seated still, Zuv entering carefully with a cup.
scene_options.eyeline: Zuv watches Aachu quietly; Aachu looks down or away.
scene_options.prop_read: Cup and saucer held apart to avoid clinking.
scene_options.visual_setting_logic: Works, but risks a common sad-couple setup.

scene_options.environment: Quiet home hallway opening into a bedroom/living-room corner.
scene_options.camera_angle: 3/4 doorway view with upper negative space
scene_options.face_visibility_plan: Aachu lower right in readable profile; Zuv lower left/mid doorway with recognizable face but slightly smaller.
scene_options.body_language: Aachu sits wrapped in silence; Zuv stands upright on socks with one foot only slightly lifted before it touches the floor.
scene_options.eyeline: Zuv's eyes go to Aachu, careful and apologetic; Aachu looks down, not at him.
scene_options.prop_read: One hand keeps the half-open door/handle from creaking; the other carries a cup with the teaspoon pinned still against the rim; curtain and chair are secondary.
scene_options.visual_setting_logic: The scene physically proves that silence has made the whole home cautious: Zuv quiets his own step and keeps one house object from making sound.
scene_options.text_placement_plan: exact quote in warm charcoal handwriting across upper-middle empty wall/paper air

scene_options.environment: Mostly empty home interior with only objects visible and the couple nearly off-frame.
scene_options.prop_read: Cup, slippers, curtain, door, chair become the emotional carriers.
scene_options.visual_setting_logic: Conceptually sharp but weak for Aachu/Zuv identity and brand character.

slides.selection_reason: Best balance of text proof, identity visibility, domestic specificity, and A Story house style.
rejected_scene_memory: Do not make a generic sad couple looking away from each other.
Do not make a quote card with decorative room details.
Do not hide both faces so identity becomes unprovable.
slides.prompt_builder_notes: Keep the room quiet but physically specific. The cup, footstep, door, and chair are the emotional proof.
